question: Which classes of celestial and semi-divine beings are encompassed in this vision?
premises: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named
They are addressed in relation to the beloved
inference: The vision or domain includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
